name: Name

names.la-hawla: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah

meanings.la-ilaha-illallah: There is no god but Allah
meanings.subhanallahi-wa-bihamdih: Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him
meanings.subhanallahil-azim: Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him, glory be to Allah, the Almighty
meanings.salawat: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad
meanings.la-hawla: There is no power and no strength except with Allah
meanings.astaghfirullah-wa-atubu: I seek Allah's forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance
meanings.hasbunallah: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best disposer of affairs
meanings.yunus: There is no god but You, glory be to You, I have indeed been among the wrongdoers
meanings.bismillah-protection: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing
meanings.audhu-bikalimat: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created
meanings.bismika-amutu: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live
meanings.rabbana-atina: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire

virtues.subhanallah: Whoever says SubhanAllah 33 times, Alhamdulillah 33 times and Allahu akbar 33 times after each prayer, and completes the hundred with La ilaha illallahu wahdahu, has their sins forgiven even if they are like the foam of the sea (Muslim 597).
virtues.alhamdulillah: The Prophet ﷺ said that Alhamdulillah fills the scale (Muslim 223).
virtues.allahu-akbar: The words most beloved to Allah are four: SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, La ilaha illallah and Allahu akbar. It does not matter which of them you begin with (Muslim 2137).
virtues.astaghfirullah: When the Prophet ﷺ finished a prayer, he said Astaghfirullah three times (Muslim 591).
virtues.tahlil: It completes the hundred after prayer, and whoever says it then has their sins forgiven even if they are like the foam of the sea (Muslim 597). Said a hundred times in a day, it equals freeing ten slaves, a hundred good deeds are written, a hundred sins are wiped out, and it protects from Shaytan until evening (Bukhari 3293).
virtues.la-ilaha-illallah: The Prophet ﷺ said that the best dhikr is La ilaha illallah, and the best dua is Alhamdulillah (Tirmidhi 3383).
virtues.subhanallahi-wa-bihamdih: Whoever says it a hundred times in the morning and in the evening, no one comes on the Day of Judgement with anything better, except someone who said the same or more (Muslim 2692). Said a hundred times in a day, it wipes out sins even if they are like the foam of the sea (Bukhari 6405).
virtues.subhanallahil-azim: The Prophet ﷺ said these are two words that are light on the tongue, heavy on the scale and beloved to the Most Merciful (Bukhari 6406).
virtues.salawat: The Prophet ﷺ said that whoever sends one blessing upon him, Allah sends ten blessings upon that person (Muslim 408).
virtues.la-hawla: The Prophet ﷺ called it one of the treasures of Paradise (Bukhari 6384).
virtues.astaghfirullah-wa-atubu: The Prophet ﷺ said: O people, turn to Allah in repentance, for I turn to Him a hundred times a day (Muslim 2702).
virtues.hasbunallah: Ibrahim ﷺ said these words when he was thrown into the fire, and Muhammad ﷺ said them when people warned that an army had gathered against them (Bukhari 4563).
virtues.yunus: It is the dua of Yunus ﷺ in the belly of the whale. The Prophet ﷺ said that no Muslim makes this dua for anything without Allah answering it (Tirmidhi 3505).
virtues.bismillah-protection: Whoever says it three times in the morning and three times in the evening, nothing will harm them (Abu Dawud 5088, Tirmidhi 3388).
virtues.audhu-bikalimat: A man was stung by a scorpion, and the Prophet ﷺ said that had he said these words in the evening, it would not have harmed him (Muslim 2709). Whoever says it when stopping at a place is not harmed until leaving it (Muslim 2708).
virtues.bismika-amutu: The Prophet ﷺ said it when he lay down to sleep, and on waking he said: Alhamdulillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur (Bukhari 6324).
virtues.rabbana-atina: It was the dua the Prophet ﷺ made most often (Bukhari 6389, Muslim 2690).

explanations.subhanallah: Tasbih means declaring Allah free of every flaw. You affirm that nothing is like Him and that He lacks nothing.
explanations.alhamdulillah: Hamd is praise and thanks together. You thank Allah for every blessing and praise Him for who He is, in good times and hard times.
explanations.allahu-akbar: Takbir means that Allah is greater than everything. Whatever fills your mind, Allah is greater.
explanations.astaghfirullah: Istighfar is asking Allah to forgive and cover your mistakes. Saying it right after prayer admits that even our worship falls short.
explanations.tahlil: It joins the testimony of tawhid with what follows from it: all dominion and all praise belong to Allah alone, and He has power over everything.
explanations.la-ilaha-illallah: This is the word of tawhid, the core of Islam. It first denies every false god, then affirms Allah alone.
explanations.subhanallahi-wa-bihamdih: It joins tasbih and hamd: you declare Allah free of every flaw while praising Him.
explanations.subhanallahil-azim: Al-Azim, the Magnificent, is one of Allah's names. The words are short, but their weight comes from what they say about Him.
explanations.salawat: Salawat is a dua for the Prophet ﷺ, asking Allah to honour and bless him. It shows love and gratitude for the one who brought the message.
explanations.la-hawla: Nothing changes and no one has strength except through Allah. It is said when something feels too heavy, letting go of relying on your own strength.
explanations.astaghfirullah-wa-atubu: Istighfar asks for forgiveness, and tawbah is turning back. Together they mean regretting the wrong, leaving it and returning to Allah.
explanations.hasbunallah: Hasb means enough: when you have Allah, you have what you need. You hand the matter to Him after doing what you can.
explanations.yunus: Yunus ﷺ said it in the darkness inside the whale. It holds three things: tawhid, glorifying Allah and admitting your own wrong.
explanations.bismillah-protection: You begin the day or the night in Allah's name and place yourself under the protection of the One who hears and knows everything.
explanations.audhu-bikalimat: Allah's perfect words are free of every flaw. You seek refuge in them from the harm of everything He created.
explanations.bismika-amutu: Sleep is like a small death. You lie down in Allah's name and trust Him with your soul until you wake.
explanations.rabbana-atina: A short dua that asks for everything: good in this life, good in the hereafter and protection from the Fire.
